# CLI Corrections (auto-generated by rtk learn)
# Run `rtk learn --write-rules` to update
#
# Cleaned up 2026-03-23: removed one-off debugging scripts, commands for
# other projects, and entries containing hardcoded credentials.
# Only project-relevant, reusable patterns are kept below.

## npm run build
- Pipe build output through `tail` to reduce noise: `npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30`

## npx tsc --noEmit
- Filter type-check output to relevant files: `npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E "file1|file2"`

## npx prisma
- Prefer `npx prisma db push` over `npx prisma migrate dev` to avoid data loss
- Check version: `npx prisma --version 2>&1 | head -3`

## curl (local API)
- Always set a timeout: `curl -s --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/api/... 2>&1 || echo "SERVER_NOT_RUNNING"`

## npx jest
- Run ingestion tests together: `npx jest src/lib/ingestion/ --no-coverage 2>&1`
